mentions.name: Build-system kernel
mentions.description: A "more sanitary" build-your-own-build-system toolkit / build-system kernel, created after the author struggled to avoid collisions in a complicated set of GNU Makefiles written for a simulation library at work.
mentions.problem: Building complicated systems with GNU Makefiles requires working hard to avoid collisions.
mentions.source_excerpt: I wrote a pretty complicated set of GNU Makefiles for a simulation library at work, but was annoyed I had to work so hard to avoid collisions, so I'm working on a "more sanitary" build-your-own-build-system/build-system-kernel type deal.

evidence.value: I wrote a pretty complicated set of GNU Makefiles for a simulation library at work, but was annoyed I had to work so hard to avoid collisions, so I'm working on a "more sanitary" build-your-own-build-system/build-system-kernel type deal.
